tools.title: Save Document
tools.description: Persist arbitrary text content (e.g. a fetched job description, notes) as a new document, optionally attached to an application. Prefer this over create_application when only saving a file is requested.

application_id.description: Optional application to attach the new document to. Omit for a library (no-application) document.

body.description: Document body. Markdown is preferred for kind=job_description. Plain text accepted otherwise.

format.description: Storage format suffix used to render the body downstream: "md" (default) for markdown/text, "txt" for plain text.

kind.description: Document kind. Use "job_description" when saving a fetched job posting, "resume" for resumes, otherwise a descriptive kind or omit to leave unclassified.

application_id.description: Application the document was attached to, when applicable

document_id.description: Local document identifier of the new document

download_url.description: Relative URL to download the saved document

tools.title: Search Companies
tools.description: Search the user's local companies by partial name. Always call this BEFORE create_company so existing matches can be reused; only fall through to create_company when no match is appropriate.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 8 when omitted.

query.description: Optional partial name to match against existing companies. Omit or empty for the most recent companies.

companies.description: Matching companies, ordered by relevance (or by recency when query is empty)

exact_key.description: True when the normalised company name exactly matches the query

similarity.description: Fuzzy-match score from 0 to 1 against the query, when one was provided

tools.title: Search Documents
tools.description: Search local documents by filename, application scope, or kind. Use when the user references a document or a file the agent hasn't already seen in the active application's listing.

application_id.description: Optional application scope: only return documents attached to this application.

kind.description: Optional document kind filter (e.g. resume, job_description, interview_transcript).

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 20 when omitted.

query.description: Optional substring to match against filenames (case-insensitive). Omit for no filename filter.
